_comment: Vendor-neutral platform identity -- the ONE file that carries your GitHub org/repo, product name, primary region, and module host. Every pinned in-repo module source (git::https://<host>/<org>/<repo>.git//...), the Go module path, the IAM deploy-role prefix, and the OIDC subject claims derive from these values. A fork sets these once and the whole tree follows. 'product' is also derivable from the live-tree folder name (terragrunt/live/<product>/...) -- keep them in sync when you rebrand.
